calibration_note: spec_version 3 = THE FROZEN SPEC (the K01 spec-version calibration law; v2's midfall occlusion cap 420 was a calibration error caught by the gate in the sealed run 689c7e7049744e41981816c20a9ce70b: the class-wide cap must admit pad_2's genuine production visibility 760 px, which EXCEEDS the fixture-composed defect pad_1's 490 px, so the undeclared-occlusion defect composition moved to the contact class where the separation is wide). Floors, occluder floors and occlusion caps calibrated from the measured production censuses (identical across dev run 3ed3e098f6794ccd8c7535672c2bd8b5 and sealed run 689c7e7049744e41981816c20a9ce70b - the renders are deterministic byte-identical): midfall ground_plane 13245 / pad_0 910 / trunk 4507 / pad_1 374 / pad_2 760 px; contact ground_plane 38971 / pad_0 5089 / trunk 5305 / pad_1 120 / pad_2 131; rest ground_plane 12406 / pad_0 910 / trunk 4052 / pad_1 21 / pad_2 21; diag layers 323/841/1042. The gate never adjusts a threshold to pass an observed frame; any change mints spec_version+1 and a new prereg hash.

declared_floor.placement_law: z_floor = min_k(lowest pad vertex z at release) - d(60); d(60) = g*DT^2*(60*61/2) derived at run from the pinned solver constants; the projections declare their centers RELATIVE to the floor surface (center_floor_rel_z) and the renderer resolves them deterministically from the recorded state

fixture_geometry.draw_order: painter depth sort, far first; declared order ground_plane(depth of its projected quad) then trunk(depth 0) then pads by mean projected depth; diag_layer always last

contact.note: the FIRST-CONTACT frame: close view at the recorded impact tick framing the pads at the declared floor plane

midfall.note: the release/fall frame mid-fall: side view from the pad_0 azimuth framing the grasp band, the fall path and the declared floor plane

rest.note: the rest frame at the declared window end: side view from the pad_0 azimuth framing the pads at rest on the declared floor plane

preregistration.exception_law: A frame passes only via an exception declared in this spec. Every exception pass emits a machine receipt row carrying the frozen law citation and measured census evidence. Prose-only exceptions are refused.
preregistration.freeze_law: Thresholds are frozen in this spec. The gate never adjusts a threshold to pass an observed frame. Any threshold or geometry change mints spec_version+1 and a new prereg hash; the receipt carries the hash of the spec actually applied. Calibration of floors/bounds from development renders happens ONLY at authoring time before the sealed run; the sealed spec_version is the freeze.
